correctness.rationale: The exact support width is the average over all 2^m subsets of max(g0,g_i selected)-min(g0,g_i selected), equal to geometrically weighted positive gaps from g0 in descending and ascending Gaussian ranks. Independent subset enumeration for m=4 with coordinates (0.25,-0.6,1.3,-0.2,0.9) agrees at 1.225. Isotropic Gaussian projection onto the zero-sum m-subspace and radial independence yield EW=2^(m+1)E M_m/E chi_m, with CDF Phi(t)((1+Phi(t))/2)^m. Upper and lower Gaussian extreme point processes converge jointly to independent Poisson limits and 2^-j weighting controls tails; the chi radius correction a_m^2/sqrt(m) vanishes. Beta-gamma identity yields ET=gamma-log 2 and Var T=pi^2/6-2Li2(1/2)+Li2(1/4); independent evaluation of twice this variance gives 1.4962113060018645. Exact expectation and first two moments follow from uniform integrability. The finite computations are checks, not infinite proofs.
